requirements.title: Rear wiper Off mode - button not pressed
requirements.description: When SWMRearWiprWshr is NotPsd, ZC shall set WasherRearReq=WasherOff and ReWinWipgReq=Off

requirements.title: Rear wiper Wiping mode - short button press
requirements.description: When SWMRearWiprWshr is Psd for less than t_button_press_rear_window (0.5s), ZC shall set WasherRearReq=WasherOff and toggle ReWinWipgReq
requirements.acceptance_criteria: ReWinWipgReq is toggled and WasherRearReq=WasherOff within 50ms when button pressed for < 0.5s

requirements.title: Rear wiper Washing mode - long button press
requirements.description: When SWMRearWiprWshr is Psd for more than t_button_press_rear_window (0.5s), ZC shall set WasherRearReq=WasherOn (held as long as button is pressed) and ReWinWipgReq=Off

parameters.washer_active_condition: as long as button is pressed

requirements.acceptance_criteria: WasherRearReq=WasherOn (held while button pressed) and ReWinWipgReq=Off within 50ms when button pressed for > 0.5s

requirements.title: Rear wiper Fault mode - SWMRearWiprWshr QF invalid
requirements.description: If the SWMRearWiprWshr qualifier flag (QF) is not valid for more than D=1500ms, ZC shall set WasherRearReq=WasherOff and ReWinWipgReq=Off
requirements.acceptance_criteria: WasherRearReq=WasherOff and ReWinWipgReq=Off within 1500ms after SWMRearWiprWshr QF becomes invalid

requirements.title: Rear wiper Fault mode - lever disconnected
requirements.description: If SWMLeLvrDiag != LeLvrConnected for more than D=1500ms, ZC shall set WasherRearReq=WasherOff and ReWinWipgReq=Off
requirements.acceptance_criteria: WasherRearReq=WasherOff and ReWinWipgReq=Off within 1500ms after SWMLeLvrDiag != LeLvrConnected

requirements.title: Rear wiper default state at startup
requirements.description: At startup when entering UM=Convenience, WasherRearReq shall default to WasherOff and ReWinWipgReq shall default to Off
requirements.acceptance_criteria: WasherRearReq=WasherOff and ReWinWipgReq=Off immediately after entering UM=Convenience

requirements.title: Rear wiper reaction time
requirements.description: ZC shall react to SWMRearWiprWshr input changes within R=50ms
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Output signal update (WasherRearReq / ReWinWipgReq) observed within 50ms of input change

requirements.title: Rear wiper Off mode - button not pressed (Ethernet)
requirements.description: When SWMRearWiprWshr is NotPsd over SOME-IP, ZC shall publish WasherRearReq=WasherOff and ReWinWipgReq=Off via SOME-IP event
requirements.acceptance_criteria: SOME-IP event 0x8001 received with WasherRearReq=WasherOff and ReWinWipgReq=Off

requirements.title: Rear wiper Wiping mode - short button press (Ethernet)
requirements.description: When SWMRearWiprWshr is Psd for less than t_button_press_rear_window (0.5s) over SOME-IP, ZC shall publish WasherRearReq=WasherOff and toggle ReWinWipgReq
requirements.acceptance_criteria: SOME-IP event 0x8001 with toggled ReWinWipgReq received within 50ms of short press release

requirements.title: Rear wiper Washing mode - long button press (Ethernet)
requirements.description: When SWMRearWiprWshr is Psd for more than t_button_press_rear_window (0.5s) over SOME-IP, ZC shall publish WasherRearReq=WasherOn (held) and ReWinWipgReq=Off

parameters.washer_active_condition: as long as button is pressed

requirements.acceptance_criteria: SOME-IP event 0x8001 with WasherRearReq=WasherOn received within 50ms of long press threshold crossing

requirements.title: Rear wiper Fault mode - SWMRearWiprWshr QF invalid (Ethernet)
requirements.description: If SWMRearWiprWshr QF is not valid for more than D=1500ms, ZC shall publish WasherRearReq=WasherOff and ReWinWipgReq=Off via SOME-IP
requirements.acceptance_criteria: SOME-IP event 0x8001 with safe state within 1500ms after QF goes invalid

requirements.title: Rear wiper Fault mode - lever disconnected (Ethernet)
requirements.description: If SWMLeLvrDiag != LeLvrConnected for more than D=1500ms, ZC shall publish WasherRearReq=WasherOff and ReWinWipgReq=Off via SOME-IP
requirements.acceptance_criteria: SOME-IP event 0x8001 with safe state within 1500ms after lever disconnect detected

requirements.title: Rear wiper default state at startup (Ethernet)
requirements.description: At startup (UM=Convenience), ZC shall publish WasherRearReq=WasherOff and ReWinWipgReq=Off via SOME-IP event before any button press
requirements.acceptance_criteria: SOME-IP event 0x8001 carries WasherRearReq=WasherOff and ReWinWipgReq=Off immediately after UM=Convenience entered

requirements.title: Rear wiper reaction time (Ethernet)
requirements.description: ZC shall publish updated output states via SOME-IP within R=50ms of SWMRearWiprWshr input change
requirements.acceptance_criteria: SOME-IP event 0x8001 observed within 50ms of SWMRearWiprWshr state change
